title: Modern Perspectives on Partial Differential Equations: Theory and Applications
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with Addis Ababa University
about: CIMPA research school hosted by the Department of Mathematics, Addis Ababa University, 26 July to 6 August 2027, on PDE theory and numerics and links with data science, machine learning and epidemiology. Designed for graduate students from East African universities. Applications close 26 March 2027.

upskill.name: Data Analytics Academy page
